sourceText:
Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

Computer Science, BS

Computer Science, BS

Today’s computing technology touches every aspect of our lives. Our computer science program prepares you for success in a wide range of industries, including tech, finance, healthcare, and gaming. Students gain a strong foundation in mathematics, algorithmic principles, and computer science theory. In addition, students get practical application experience through a senior capstone design project. Graduates of this degree are ready to design and develop the software and computer systems of the future.

Course Maps

A course map is a quick guide to help students figure out which courses to take each quarter. Course maps were written by BC faculty, who have used their expertise to recommend specific courses students can take to achieve their academic or career goals. Students should meet with an advisor to learn more.

Program Catalog Page

          Points of Pride

Empowered by Innovation

A comprehensive computer science education prepares you for success in vaious industries, including tech, finance, healthcare, and gaming.

Maximizing Potential

In 2022 Amazon announced a $1.5M gift to this program, providing assistance to students, particularly those from underrepresented populations.

Personalized Support

With small class sizes, hands-on activities, and an emphasis on introductory learning, this program focuses on your success.

          Featured Faculty

          See the Computer Science Faculty Page

Dr. Sara Farag

Program Chair

Dr. Farag has a doctoral degree in computer science and computer graphics from Deakin University in Melbourne, Australia. After joining Swinburne University’s online team as an education technologist and web developer, she became a course coordinator and lecturer for web design courses there. 

                Dr. Farag's Full Bio

Alfred Nehme

Faculty

Alfred Nehme received his B.S. degree from The Ohio State University and M.S. degree in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin – Madison. Prior to joining Bellevue College he worked for 20 years in the software engineering industry.

Computer Science Student Advisory Board

The CS Student Advisory Board is a group of students within the Bachelors in Computer Science Program dedicated to promoting and building the Computer Science Community at Bellevue College.

The club's mission is to facilitate student engagement and community building; acting as a liaison between the students and faculty to promote positive growth within the BC CS community.

Technology and Data

STEM

Computer Science, BS: Data Science Emphasis

Bachelor Degree

Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science with an emphasis in Data Science from Bellevue College meets the critical and pervasive demand for rigorously trained computer science professionals specializing in Data Science. This degree program will prepare graduates to use mathematics, statistics, artificial intelligence algorithms, scientific computing, and systems to analyze, design, and implement data-driven systems, enabling them to derive insights and solutions from complex datasets of varying size and complexity.
